Department of Health and Human Services.title: California CY2024 Medicaid drug reimbursements by quarter
Department of Health and Human Services.basis: Official CMS State Drug Utilization Data disclose $15,506,717,427.98 of California Medicaid Amount Reimbursed for calendar 2024. The four signed quarter totals reconcile exactly to that disclosed total and are ranked largest first. This is gross Medicaid reimbursement across federal and state funding, before rebates and with suppressed dollar records excluded; it is a separate source view, not an additive split of the FY2024 CMS-64 federal-share row.

Department of Health and Human Services.title: California CY2024 largest disclosed Medicaid drug products
Department of Health and Human Services.basis: The ten largest California NDC aggregates in official CMS State Drug Utilization Data total $2,618,545,457.50 of disclosed calendar-2024 Medicaid Amount Reimbursed. This is a ranked partial product view, not a complete claims total and not an additive split of CMS-64 federal share; suppressed dollar records and all other products are omitted rather than hidden inside an oversized residual.
